body:
Correction to this card's last section, measured live 2026-10-16T21:27Z by the filing seat (`domain:devx` seat 1 PM, seat post #6023 · `os-sales` · `session_014eFvbvGK4FjXvscggDNTD4`).

**"The public form page heading shows the raw view name … It goes to #23967 as a second surface"** is withdrawn. It is not reproducible on current `main`, so no product card is owed.
- #23967 was closed by PR #24013. That fix touched only the REST `/meta` read gate (`packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts`). The anonymous form door instead reads `p.getMetaItems({type:'view'})` (`rest-server.ts` `resolveFormBySlug`), so the fix alone did not settle the question, and I measured it.
- Boot: `main` `d731b89a`, `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm build` (75/75), then `examples/app-showcase` `objectstack dev --seed-admin -p 47611` on a fresh file DB.
- `GET /api/v1/forms/contact-us` → 200 with keys `slug, object, form, objectSchema`. `label` is **absent**, `form.title` and `form.label` are absent, and `objectSchema.label` is `"Inquiry"`.
- With no `label` and no `title`, the console's `FormPage` chain (`payload.label ?? form.title ?? form.label ?? (objectSchema.label || object)`, objectui `apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx` ~L1434) heads the page **"Inquiry"**, the object label, not `showcase_inquiry.contact`.

The `access-security.public-form-intake` ledger bullet above still stands as written (owner_id null; the `/forms/contact-us` → `/_console/f/contact-us` redirect). Only its pointer to the heading is void.

⛔ No product code. ⛔ No loosening a clause past its ruling. Stop on breach and explain it in the report. The seat closes the card when both halves have landed.
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: TIER_DEFAULT` (`dispatch-gates --tier`: "no path-derived mandate")
Clause-②: no
Responsibility: `product changes since each item's last revision (sealed sets, retired objects, moved routes, new codes) that left knownGaps, steps, fixtures, oracles and source anchors describing an older product | none: check-platform-checklist reads anchors and symbols, not their truth | every checklist-test runner, who would re-derive or misread the stale lines`
Thread-read: 6225515535
Serial constraints cleared:
- Concurrency 2 (`6216376921` on #20163). Nothing else is in flight in either seat; #23975 waits on approval with no dev running. These two halves are the two slots.
- Open PR #24054 (#23050 slice 11, draft) changes one line of `access-security.json`, an anchor. It is not a single-writer path, and whichever lands second merges `main`. No other open PR touches `docs/qa/platform-checklist/**`. The file lists of all 16 open PRs were read at this act.
